answer.rationale: The incumbent will not meet the required cost reduction, while switching the entire primary supply would create transition risk with the line already at 94% of committed volume and no buffer. A guarded second-source introduction can create price competition and capture low-cost supply while preserving incumbent continuity and reducing single-source delivery exposure. The archived records on low-cost-vendor onboarding and successful dual sourcing are the most relevant evidence to verify before committing.
